name: Toodee and Topdee 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Toodee and Topdee is a unique puzzle game where cosmic turbulence caused the 2D Platformer and the Top-Down Puzzler dimensions to merge! Switch between Toodee and Topdee and their unique perspectives to overcome hard-as-nails challenges, solve mind-melting puzzles and defeat huge bosses.
